rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a person's spiritual essence, including one believed to survive death.

example.english: Where does the soul go after a person dies?
example.traditional: 人死咗之後，靈魂會去邊度？
example.jyutping: jan4 sei2 zo2 zi1 hau6 ling4 wan4 wui5 heoi3 bin1 dou6

rows.note: Use this everyday word when “souls” simply means individual people, especially in a count.

example.english: Every soul here has a ticket.
example.jyutping: ni1 dou6 mui5 go3 jan4 dou1 jau5 fei1

rows.note: Use this when the sense focuses on individual human lives, especially lives lost or at risk.

example.english: During a fire, saving even one soul matters most.
example.traditional: 火警嗰陣，救一條人命最緊要。
example.jyutping: fo2 ging2 go2 zan6 gau3 jat1 tiu4 jan4 meng6 zeoi3 gan2 jiu3
